entities.summary: Aldrick Rosas al-DREEK row-SOS; is an American former professional football player who was a placekicker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Southern Oregon Raiders. Rosas was selected to the Pro Bowl for the 2018 season as a member of the New York Giants.
